purpose: Approved Lusain Volt boss character, side racing, intro/winner gesture and top replay
sourceHandling: Generated PNG bytes preserved without image post-processing. Atlas source rectangles, anchors and top orientation are calibrated at runtime in lib/playground-sprint-boss-sprites.mjs.
notes: The approved character boards define identity and uniform. Existing green athlete atlases were pose/camera guides only.
Realistic run has uneven row boundaries [0,336,632,939,1254]. Voxel top frames 4..7 are rotated clockwise at runtime.
No real sports-brand marks, credentials or company material are included.

Use case: identity-preserve. Create production game character SPRITE ATLAS assets by editing the supplied approved LUSAIN VOLT character board. Reference image 1 is the authoritative identity and costume reference. The SAME original tall long-legged adult Black male sprinter, dark-brown skin, closely cropped black hair, confident charismatic face, golden yellow singlet with emerald-green side panels, black fitted shorts with green trim, lime-yellow sprint spike shoes. Preserve the approved face and mature lean powerful anatomy. Keep the original small lightning emblem and small VOLT bib if legible; absolutely NO real sports brands, swoosh/checkmark logos, leaping-animal marks, federation/olympic marks. Same character, clothing, proportions and light in EVERY cell.
Output real transparent-alpha PNG: no background at all, no ground plane, no shadows baked into the image, no colored matte, no checkerboard, no UI, no border/grid, no text outside the clothing, no frame labels. The character must be an isolated clean cutout in each cell, fully inside it without overlapping neighbors or clipping hands/shoes/head. Generous TRANSPARENT margins around every figure: at least 10% cell width on sides, at least 12% height above/below every figure. Body scale must be stable across the entire atlas. Figures smaller in cells are preferable to clipping. Fixed camera, fixed focal length, consistent torso origin and warm afternoon key light/cool fill.
Reference image 2 is ONLY a pose/camera/grid guide, NOT the character identity or costume. Replace its athlete with Lusain from reference 1. Deliver exactly FOUR COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, 16 equal cells, near-square atlas. All16 cells show RUNNING poses in strict LATERAL SIDE VIEW travelling RIGHT. Keep pelvis near50% width/53% height, nominal ground line82% height and ordinary head near18%; whole athlete only65% cell height. The front arm and leg alternate correctly, knees bend naturally forward and hands never merge into torso.
A complete continuous right-plus-left stride loops across row-major frames0..15. 0 near-right foot touches ground forward, left knee recovering; 1 loading on right foot; 2 right midstance under hip; 3 right forefoot pushes backward; 4 right toe-off behind hip, left knee raised forward; 5 flight with right leg back and left shin unfolding; 6 left foot approaches ground ahead; 7 smooth left-foot descent; 8 opposite left-foot touchdown with opposite arm swing from0; 9 left loading; 10 left midstance; 11 left forefoot push; 12 left toe-off/right knee forward; 13 opposite flight; 14 right foot approaches ground; 15 right-foot descent returning smoothly to0. Contact frames0-4,7-12,15 retain stable imaginary sole baseline; flight5,6,13,14 have natural clearance above it. Do not repeat one same lead leg and arm all through the loop. Skin/cloth detail and readable silhouette remain sharp, no motion blur.
Photographic realism matching the approved board: natural skin pores, long lean muscle/tendon anatomy, realistic technical fabric, crisp sports-photography light. No vector/cartoon/mannequin/plastic look.
